verdict.rationale: incident.io documents a public REST API with an API reference and a downloadable OpenAPI 3.0 spec, a dedicated Status Page API, and a Terraform provider, so programmatic access to the product is first-party. Nothing in the evidence shows the API matches everything the UI can do, and the Terraform provider is still being built out resource by resource. missing for 10: evidence of API/UI parity across all features (e.g. incidents, timelines, post-mortems, workflows, insights, schedules), an endpoint coverage inventory, independent hands-on confirmation of parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: This is the API reference for incident.io. It documents available API endpoints, provides examples of how to use them, and covers authentication, rate limits, and error handling.
Download the full OpenAPI 3.0 spec to generate

incident.io provides two APIs for status pages: the Status Page API for programmatically managing incidents and maintenance windows, and the Widget API for embedding status data into your own product.
We're working through our Terraform provider resource by resource to make your infra-as-code setup easier to understand and maintain.
